rules.sentence: To confirm a proper diagnosis of PsA, it is important to identify psoriasis distinguishing it from other cutaneous diseases that may mimic it.
The onset of psoriasis precedes that of PsA in most cases.
Both diseases occasionally occur at the same time or, in rare cases, PsA precedes psoriasis.
